findings.issue_text: [Medium/bug] pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:46 — TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver (or a state-sharing copy), so every log record emitted through FromContext is written to a discarded instance; since LoggerMiddleware.logRequest now logs 'Plugin Request Completed' via m.logger.FromContext(ctx), tests that inject a TestLogger can no longer capture or assert on those logs, and contextual attributes (pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID, uname) can never be verified through the fake.

[Medium/test_gap] pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go — the new middleware ships with no test file at all, and no test anywhere verifies that LoggerMiddleware still emits pluginId/endpoint/dsName/dsUID/uname now that those fields come from context attributes instead of explicit log params; the renamed metrics test only covers the metrics behavior, so the relocated context-enrichment logic lost its coverage.

[Low/data] pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:49 — the grafana-data-egress log event no longer includes traceID (the tracing.TraceIDFromContext call was removed); this is only regression-free if the infra logger's FromContext automatically attaches trace identifiers from the active span, otherwise plugin request logs silently lose trace correlation — also a behavioral telemetry change hidden in a PR titled as a pure rename, worth confirming before merge.

[Low/doc_defect] pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go:8 — ContextualLoggerMiddleware's doc says nothing about middleware stack placement, dropping the old InstrumentationMiddleware warning that it 'should live at the top of the middleware stack' because it enriched the context; LoggerMiddleware's log output now has a hidden dependency on ContextualLoggerMiddleware being installed before it (see pluginsintegration.go), and a future reordering or standalone use would silently drop pluginId/endpoint/ds fields from logs with no error.

[Low/bug] pkg/plugins/log/logger.go:47 — grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext type-asserts the underlying logger's result to *log.ConcreteLogger and silently falls back to d.New() on failure, discarding all contextual attributes with no signal; this brittle concrete-type coupling means any non-ConcreteLogger infra logger implementation silently produces context-free logs instead of failing loudly or wrapping whatever Logger was returned.

goldens.comment: The ContextualLoggerMiddleware methods (QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, CollectMetrics) panic when a nil request is received. This occurs because they directly access req.PluginContext (via the instrumentContext function) without first checking if req is nil. This is a regression, as previous middleware layers gracefully handled nil requests.

The traceID is no longer logged for plugin requests. During a refactoring, the tracing import and the logic to extract and add traceID from the context to log parameters were removed from the LoggerMiddleware. The newly introduced ContextualLoggerMiddleware does not add this information, resulting in missing traceID in plugin request logs and impacting debugging and request tracing capabilities.

The `TestLogger.FromContext` method returns a new `TestLogger` instance via `NewTestLogger()` instead of returning the receiver (f). This causes logs to be recorded on an un-referenced instance, leading to broken test assertions that expect logs to be recorded on the original logger.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/test_gap] pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go — the new middleware ships with no test file at all, and no test anywhere verifies that LoggerMiddleware still emits pluginId/endpoint/dsName/dsUID/uname now that those fields come from context attributes instead of explicit log params; the renamed metrics test only covers the metrics behavior, so the relocated context-enrichment logic lost its coverage.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces new nontrivial behavior in `pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go` (it enriches `context.Context` via `log.WithContextualAttributes` based on endpoint/plugin/user/datasource fields) and wires it into the middleware stack in `CreateMiddlewares(...)`, while `LoggerMiddleware` simultaneously removes explicit `pluginId`/`endpoint`/`dsName`/`dsUID`/`uname` log params and instead relies on `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` to pick them up from the context. The diff adds/renames only metrics-related tests (`metrics_middleware_test.go`) and does not add any test covering the new contextual-logger middleware or verifying that `LoggerMiddleware` still emits those attributes after the change, so this is a concrete test coverage gap created by the refactor.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/doc_defect] pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go:8 — ContextualLoggerMiddleware's doc says nothing about middleware stack placement, dropping the old InstrumentationMiddleware warning that it 'should live at the top of the middleware stack' because it enriched the context; LoggerMiddleware's log output now has a hidden dependency on ContextualLoggerMiddleware being installed before it (see pluginsintegration.go), and a future reordering or standalone use would silently drop pluginId/endpoint/ds fields from logs with no error.

adjudication.rationale: The diff moves context enrichment (pluginId/endpoint/dsName/dsUID/uname) out of the old InstrumentationMiddleware into the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware (instrumentContext -> log.WithContextualAttributes). LoggerMiddleware now logs via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` and no longer appends plugin/request fields itself (removed `pluginCtx`/`endpoint` params and associated logParams). In `CreateMiddlewares`, ContextualLoggerMiddleware is currently placed before LoggerMiddleware, so behavior is preserved, but LoggerMiddleware now has an implicit ordering/installation dependency: if ContextualLoggerMiddleware is omitted or reordered after LoggerMiddleware, those fields silently disappear from logs. The new middleware’s doc comment does not mention this placement requirement, whereas the old InstrumentationMiddleware comment explicitly warned it should be at the top of the stack.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] pkg/plugins/log/logger.go:47 — grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext type-asserts the underlying logger's result to *log.ConcreteLogger and silently falls back to d.New() on failure, discarding all contextual attributes with no signal; this brittle concrete-type coupling means any non-ConcreteLogger infra logger implementation silently produces context-free logs instead of failing loudly or wrapping whatever Logger was returned.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext which does `d.l.FromContext(ctx).(*log.ConcreteLogger)` and, on failure, falls back to `d.New()` (dropping the supplied `ctx`). This is a concrete-type coupling and silent fallback behavior introduced by the change. However, from the diff alone we cannot verify that `d.l.FromContext(ctx)` can ever return a non-*log.ConcreteLogger in current usage (the wrapper likely wraps ConcreteLogger already), so it’s more of a robustness/architecture concern than a demonstrable defect.
